usajmo-2016-q1.summary: An isosceles triangle $ABC$ with $AB=AC$ is inscribed in a circle $\omega$. A point $P$ varies on the arc $BC$ not containing $A$. Let $I_B$ and $I_C$ be the incentres of triangles $ABP$ and $ACP$, respectively. Prove that the circumcircle of $PI_BI_C$ always passes through one fixed point.
usajmo-2016-q1.summaryZh: 等腰三角形 $ABC$ 满足 $AB=AC$，并内接于圆 $\omega$。点 $P$ 在不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 上变化。分别记三角形 $ABP$ 与 $ACP$ 的内心为 $I_B,I_C$。证明：三角形 $PI_BI_C$ 的外接圆恒过一个定点。
usajmo-2016-q1.answer: The fixed point is the midpoint $M$ of the arc $BC$ not containing $A$.
usajmo-2016-q1.answerZh: 定点是不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 的中点 $M$。

methods.title: Use arc midpoints and the two incentres
methods.titleZh: 利用弧中点与两个内心
steps: Let $M$ be the midpoint of the arc $BC$ not containing $A$. Let $M_B$ be the second intersection of $PI_B$ with $\omega$, and define $M_C$ similarly from $PI_C$. In triangle $ABP$, the point $M_B$ is the midpoint of the arc $AB$ not containing $P$; hence the standard incenter lemma gives $M_BI_B=M_BB$. Similarly, $M_CI_C=M_CC$.

Because $AB=AC$, the corresponding arcs on the two sides of the symmetry axis $AM$ are equal. Consequently $M_BB=M_CC$ and $MM_B=MM_C$. Moreover, $P,I_B,M_B$ are collinear and $P,I_C,M_C$ are collinear, so both angles $\angle I_BM_BM$ and $\angle I_CM_CM$ subtend the same chord $PM$ of $\omega$. Thus triangles $I_BM_BM$ and $I_CM_CM$ are congruent by SAS, giving $MI_B=MI_C$.

The points $A$ and $M$ are antipodal on $\omega$, so $PM\perp PA$. Also $\angle APB=\angle APC$ because arcs $AB$ and $AC$ are equal; after bisecting these angles, the ray $PA$ bisects $\angle I_BPI_C$. We now use the following elementary lemma: if two rays from $P$ are symmetric about a line through $P$, a point $M$ lies on the perpendicular through $P$, and $MI_B=MI_C$, then $P,I_B,M,I_C$ are cyclic.

For completeness, put $P=(0,0)$, take the symmetry line as the $x$-axis and write $M=(0,m)$, $I_B=r(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$, $I_C=s(\cos\theta,-\sin\theta)$. The equality $MI_B=MI_C$ gives $r-s=2m\sin\theta$. The circle through $P,I_B,I_C$ has equation $x^2+y^2+ux+vy=0$; subtracting the two equations for $I_B,I_C$ yields $v=-m$, so $M$ also satisfies the circle equation. Hence the circumcircle of $PI_BI_C$ always passes through the fixed point $M$.
stepsZh: 设 $M$ 为不含 $A$ 的弧 $BC$ 的中点。令 $M_B$ 为直线 $PI_B$ 与 $\omega$ 的另一交点，类似定义 $M_C$。在三角形 $ABP$ 中，$M_B$ 是不含 $P$ 的弧 $AB$ 的中点，由内心的弧中点性质可得 $M_BI_B=M_BB$；同理 $M_CI_C=M_CC$。

由 $AB=AC$，圆上关于对称轴 $AM$ 的对应弧相等，从而 $M_BB=M_CC$ 且 $MM_B=MM_C$。又因为 $P,I_B,M_B$ 共线，$P,I_C,M_C$ 共线，所以 $\angle I_BM_BM$ 与 $\angle I_CM_CM$ 都是弦 $PM$ 所对的圆周角。由边角边可知 $\triangle I_BM_BM\cong\triangle I_CM_CM$，故 $MI_B=MI_C$。

$A,M$ 是 $\omega$ 上的一对对径点，因此 $PM\perp PA$。又因弧 $AB$ 与弧 $AC$ 相等，有 $\angle APB=\angle APC$；分别作角平分线后，射线 $PA$ 平分 $\angle I_BPI_C$。使用如下初等引理：从 $P$ 引出的两条射线关于一条直线对称，$M$ 位于过 $P$ 的垂线上，且 $MI_B=MI_C$，则 $P,I_B,M,I_C$ 四点共圆。

为验证该引理，取 $P=(0,0)$，以对称轴为 $x$ 轴，写成 $M=(0,m)$、$I_B=r(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$、$I_C=s(\cos\theta,-\sin\theta)$。由 $MI_B=MI_C$ 得 $r-s=2m\sin\theta$。过 $P,I_B,I_C$ 的圆可写成 $x^2+y^2+ux+vy=0$；把 $I_B,I_C$ 代入并相减得到 $v=-m$，于是 $M$ 也满足圆方程。因此 $PI_BI_C$ 的外接圆恒过定点 $M$。

usajmo-2016-q2.summary: Prove that there is a positive integer $n<10^6$ for which the decimal representation of $5^n$ contains six consecutive zeros.
usajmo-2016-q2.summaryZh: 证明：存在正整数 $n<10^6$，使得 $5^n$ 的十进制表示中含有连续六个零。
usajmo-2016-q2.answer: One valid choice is $n=20+2^{19}=524308$; the last twenty digits of $5^n$ are $00000095367431640625$.

methods.title: Force the last twenty digits with congruences
steps: Since $\varphi(2^{20})=2^{19}$ and $5$ is coprime to $2^{20}$, Euler's theorem gives $5^{2^{19}}\equiv1\pmod{2^{20}}$. Therefore $5^n=5^{20}5^{2^{19}}\equiv5^{20}\pmod{2^{20}}$.

The moduli $2^{20}$ and $5^{20}$ are coprime, so the two congruences combine to $5^n\equiv5^{20}\pmod{10^{20}}$. Hence the final twenty decimal digits of $5^n$ are the twenty-digit, zero-padded form of $5^{20}$.
Now $5^{20}=95367431640625$ has only fourteen digits. Padding it to twenty digits gives $00000095367431640625$, which contains six consecutive zeros.
stepsZh: $2^{20}$ 与 $5^{20}$ 互素，由中国剩余定理得到 $5^n\equiv5^{20}\pmod{10^{20}}$。所以 $5^n$ 的末二十位就是把 $5^{20}$ 在左侧补零得到的二十位数。

usajmo-2016-q3.summary: Let $X_1,X_2,\ldots,X_{100}$ be mutually distinct nonempty subsets of a set $S$. For every $i=1,\ldots,99$, consecutive sets satisfy $X_i\cap X_{i+1}=\varnothing$ and $X_i\cup X_{i+1}\ne S$. Determine the smallest possible value of $|S|$.
usajmo-2016-q3.summaryZh: 设 $X_1,X_2,\ldots,X_{100}$ 是集合 $S$ 的两两不同的非空子集。对每个 $i=1,\ldots,99$，相邻两项满足 $X_i\cap X_{i+1}=\varnothing$ 且 $X_i\cup X_{i+1}\ne S$。求 $|S|$ 的最小可能值。

methods.title: Exclude seven elements and construct a chain on eight
methods.titleZh: 排除七元集合并构造八元集合
steps: At least seven elements are needed for $100$ distinct subsets. Suppose $|S|=7$. If $|X_i|\ge4$, either neighbour is disjoint from $X_i$ and omits an element outside $X_i$, so it has size at most $2$.

There are only $\binom71+\binom72=28$ nonempty subsets of size at most $2$. Sets of size at least $4$ must be separated by such small sets, so at most $29$ large sets can appear. There are only $\binom73=35$ three-element sets. Thus the sequence has length at most $28+29+35=92<100$, a contradiction. Therefore $|S|\ge8$.
It remains to build a sufficiently long sequence. For $S_4=\{1,2,3,4\}$, the following nine sets work (digits denote the contained elements): $34,1,23,4,12,3,14,2,13$.

Suppose a valid chain on $S_n=\{1,\ldots,n\}$ has length $2^{n-1}+1$. Delete its last set to obtain an even-length chain $C$. Join two copies of $C$ with the empty set, then add $n+1$ to every odd-positioned set. The middle term becomes $\{n+1\}$.

Adjacent sets remain disjoint, and their union still misses an old element. The two copies are distinct because the alternating $n+1$ pattern reverses after the middle term. The new length is $2^n+1$; for $n=8$ it is $129$. Taking the first $100$ sets proves the minimum is $8$.
stepsZh: 要有 $100$ 个不同子集，至少需要七个元素。反设 $|S|=7$。若 $|X_i|\ge4$，相邻集合既与 $X_i$ 不交，又须漏掉 $X_i$ 外的一个元素，故大小至多为 $2$。
大小不超过 $2$ 的非空子集只有 $\binom71+\binom72=28$ 个。大小至少为 $4$ 的集合之间必须由这种小集合隔开，所以大集合最多有 $29$ 个；三元子集只有 $\binom73=35$ 个。序列长度至多为 $28+29+35=92<100$，矛盾。因此 $|S|\ge8$。
下面构造足够长的序列。在 $S_4=\{1,2,3,4\}$ 上，以下九个集合满足条件（数字表示集合中的元素）：$34,1,23,4,12,3,14,2,13$。
设 $S_n=\{1,\ldots,n\}$ 上已有长度 $2^{n-1}+1$ 的合法链。删去末项得偶数长度的链 $C$。用空集连接两个 $C$，再在每个奇数位置加入 $n+1$；中间项便成为 $\{n+1\}$。
相邻集合仍不交，且仍漏掉一个旧元素；中间项后奇偶性反转，故两个副本不会重复。新链长度为 $2^n+1$。当 $n=8$ 时有 $129$ 项，取前 $100$ 项即可。因此最小值为 $8$。

usajmo-2016-q4.summary: Find, with proof, the least integer $N$ such that after any $2016$ elements are removed from $\{1,2,\ldots,N\}$, the remaining set still contains $2016$ distinct numbers whose sum is $N$.
usajmo-2016-q4.summaryZh: 求最小整数 $N$，使得从 $\{1,2,\ldots,N\}$ 中任意删去 $2016$ 个元素后，余下元素中仍能找到 $2016$ 个互不相同的数，其和等于 $N$。

methods.title: A sharp lower bound and complementary pairs
steps: Delete $1,2,\ldots,2016$. Any remaining $2016$ distinct positive integers have sum at least $2017+2018+\cdots+4032$. Therefore every admissible $N$ must satisfy $N\ge2017+\cdots+4032$.
This lower bound equals $1008(2017+4032)=1008\cdot6049=6097392$. Set $N$ equal to this value.

Consider the $3024$ disjoint pairs $(1,6048),(2,6047),\ldots,(3024,3025)$, each with sum $6049$. Deleting one element can destroy at most one pair, so deleting $2016$ elements leaves at least $3024-2016=1008$ intact pairs.
The $1008$ intact pairs contain $2016$ distinct remaining numbers, and their sum is $1008\cdot6049=N$. Thus this $N$ works and is minimal.
stepsZh: 先删去 $1,2,\ldots,2016$。余下集合中任意 $2016$ 个不同正整数的和至少为 $2017+2018+\cdots+4032$，所以所有满足条件的 $N$ 都必须不小于该值。
考虑 $3024$ 对互不相交的数 $(1,6048),(2,6047),\ldots,(3024,3025)$，每对之和均为 $6049$。删去一个元素至多破坏一对，因此删去 $2016$ 个元素后，至少还有 $3024-2016=1008$ 对完整保留。
这 $1008$ 对恰含 $2016$ 个不同的未删元素，其总和为 $1008\cdot6049=N$。所以该 $N$ 确实可行，并且由下界知它最小。

usajmo-2016-q5.summary: Let $ABC$ be an acute triangle with circumcentre $O$. Let $H$ be the foot of the perpendicular from $A$ to $BC$, and let $P,Q$ be the feet of the perpendiculars from $H$ to $AB,AC$, respectively. Given $AH^2=2AO^2$, prove that $O,P,Q$ are collinear.
usajmo-2016-q5.summaryZh: 设 $ABC$ 为锐角三角形，$O$ 为其外心。$H$ 是 $A$ 到 $BC$ 的垂足，$P,Q$ 分别是 $H$ 到 $AB,AC$ 的垂足。已知 $AH^2=2AO^2$，证明 $O,P,Q$ 三点共线。
usajmo-2016-q5.answer: The line $PQ$ passes through the circumcentre $O$.

methods.title: Cyclic quadrilaterals and power of a point
steps: The right triangles $AHP$ and $ABH$ give $AP=AH\sin B$ and $AH=AB\sin B$, so $AP\cdot AB=AH^2$. Similarly, $AQ\cdot AC=AH^2$. Hence $AP\cdot AB=AQ\cdot AC$, and the converse of the intersecting-chords theorem shows that $B,P,Q,C$ are cyclic.

Because $P$ lies on $AB$ and $Q$ lies on $AC$, cyclicity gives $\angle BPQ=\angle BCQ=\angle BCA$. By the tangent-chord theorem, the tangent to the circumcircle of $ABC$ at $A$ makes the same angle with $AB$; hence $PQ$ is parallel to that tangent and therefore $PQ\perp AO$.

Let $D$ be the point diametrically opposite $A$ on the circumcircle, and let $K=AD\cap PQ$. Since $AD$ is the line $AO$ and $PQ\perp AO$, we have $\angle QKD=90^\circ$. Also $Q$ lies on $AC$ and $AD$ is a diameter, so $\angle QCD=\angle ACD=90^\circ$. Thus $K,Q,C,D$ are cyclic.

Taking power from $A$ to this circle gives $AK\cdot AD=AQ\cdot AC=AH^2$. Now $AD=2AO$ and the hypothesis says $AH^2=2AO^2$, so $AK=AH^2/AD=AO$. Both $K$ and $O$ lie on the ray $AD$, hence $K=O$. Since $K$ lies on $PQ$, the points $O,P,Q$ are collinear.
stepsZh: 由直角三角形 $AHP$ 与 $ABH$ 可得 $AP=AH\sin B$、$AH=AB\sin B$，所以 $AP\cdot AB=AH^2$。同理 $AQ\cdot AC=AH^2$。于是 $AP\cdot AB=AQ\cdot AC$，由相交弦定理的逆命题可知 $B,P,Q,C$ 四点共圆。
因为 $P$ 在 $AB$ 上、$Q$ 在 $AC$ 上，共圆给出 $\angle BPQ=\angle BCQ=\angle BCA$。由切弦定理，$ABC$ 外接圆在 $A$ 点的切线与 $AB$ 的夹角也等于 $\angle BCA$，故 $PQ$ 平行于该切线，从而 $PQ\perp AO$。
设 $D$ 为外接圆上与 $A$ 对径的点，令 $K=AD\cap PQ$。由于 $AD$ 与 $AO$ 共线且 $PQ\perp AO$，有 $\angle QKD=90^\circ$。又因 $Q$ 在 $AC$ 上且 $AD$ 为直径，$\angle QCD=\angle ACD=90^\circ$。所以 $K,Q,C,D$ 四点共圆。
从点 $A$ 对该圆使用点幂，得到 $AK\cdot AD=AQ\cdot AC=AH^2$。又 $AD=2AO$，题设给出 $AH^2=2AO^2$，故 $AK=AH^2/AD=AO$。$K,O$ 都位于射线 $AD$ 上，因此 $K=O$。而 $K$ 在 $PQ$ 上，故 $O,P,Q$ 共线。

usajmo-2016-q6.summary: Find all functions $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ such that for every real $x,y$, $(f(x)+xy)f(x-3y)+(f(y)+xy)f(3x-y)=f(x+y)^2$.
usajmo-2016-q6.summaryZh: 求所有函数 $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$，使得对任意实数 $x,y$，都有 $(f(x)+xy)f(x-3y)+(f(y)+xy)f(3x-y)=f(x+y)^2$。

methods.title: Reduce every value to zero or a square
methods.titleZh: 把每个函数值限制为零或平方
steps: Write the equation as $P(x,y)$. From $P(0,0)$ we get $f(0)=0$. From $P(0,y)$ and $P(0,-y)$, we obtain $f(y)f(-y)=f(y)^2=f(-y)^2$; if either value is zero then both are zero, and otherwise division gives equality. Hence $f$ is even.
Set $y=-x$. Evenness and $f(0)=0$ yield $2(f(x)-x^2)f(4x)=0$. Thus for every $x$, either $f(x)=x^2$ or $f(4x)=0$. Call this fact (1).

Next put $(x,y)=(3t,t)$. The equation becomes $(f(t)+3t^2)f(8t)=f(4t)^2$. If $f(4t)
e0$, then $f(8t)
e0$. After relabelling, this says $f(z)
e0\Rightarrow f(2z)
e0$, or contrapositively $f(2z)=0\Rightarrow f(z)=0$.

If $f(4t)
e0$, fact (1) gives $f(t)=t^2
e0$, and the preceding implication gives $f(2t)
e0$. Its contrapositive is $f(2t)=0\Rightarrow f(4t)=0$. Combining the two directions gives $f(z)=0$ if and only if $f(2z)=0$.
In fact (1), the alternative $f(4x)=0$ is now equivalent to $f(x)=0$. Therefore, for every real $x$, either $f(x)=x^2$ or $f(x)=0$. In particular $f(x)\ge0$ everywhere.

Assume $f(a)=0$ for some $a\ne0$. By evenness take $a>0$. Repeatedly using the zero-scaling equivalence gives $f(2^na)=0$. For an arbitrary $b>0$, choose $c=2^na>b$ and set $x=(3c+b)/4$, $y=(c-b)/4$. Then $x,y>0$, $x-3y=b$, and $x+y=c$.

Substitution gives $0=f(c)^2=(f(x)+xy)f(b)+(f(y)+xy)f(3x-y)$. Every factor is nonnegative and $xy>0$, so the first coefficient is positive and therefore $f(b)=0$. Evenness then gives $f\equiv0$ on all reals.
If no nonzero zero exists, the dichotomy forces $f(x)=x^2$ for all $x\ne0$, and also at $0$. Direct substitution verifies that both $f\equiv0$ and $f(x)=x^2$ satisfy the original equation.
stepsZh: 把原方程记为 $P(x,y)$。由 $P(0,0)$ 得 $f(0)=0$。分别使用 $P(0,y)$ 与 $P(0,-y)$，得到 $f(y)f(-y)=f(y)^2=f(-y)^2$；若其中一个为零，则两者都为零，否则相除即可得到二者相等。因此 $f$ 为偶函数。
令 $y=-x$。利用偶性和 $f(0)=0$，得到 $2(f(x)-x^2)f(4x)=0$。所以对每个 $x$，要么 $f(x)=x^2$，要么 $f(4x)=0$。记为结论 (1)。

再取 $(x,y)=(3t,t)$，原方程化为 $(f(t)+3t^2)f(8t)=f(4t)^2$。若 $f(4t)
e0$，则 $f(8t)
e0$。换元后即 $f(z)

e0$，其逆否命题为 $f(2z)=0\Rightarrow f(z)=0$。

e0$，再由上一蕴含得 $f(2t)

在结论 (1) 中，$f(4x)=0$ 现与 $f(x)=0$ 等价。因此对每个实数 $x$，都有 $f(x)=x^2$ 或 $f(x)=0$。特别地，$f$ 处处非负。
若存在 $a\ne0$ 使 $f(a)=0$，由偶性可设 $a>0$。反复使用零点伸缩等价关系，得到 $f(2^na)=0$。任取 $b>0$，选择 $c=2^na>b$，并令 $x=(3c+b)/4$、$y=(c-b)/4$。于是 $x,y>0$、$x-3y=b$ 且 $x+y=c$。
代回方程得到 $0=f(c)^2=(f(x)+xy)f(b)+(f(y)+xy)f(3x-y)$。所有因子均非负且 $xy>0$，第一项的系数严格为正，所以 $f(b)=0$。再由偶性可得 $f\equiv0$。
若不存在非零零点，上述二分结论迫使所有 $x\ne0$ 都满足 $f(x)=x^2$，在 $x=0$ 处也成立。直接代入可验证 $f\equiv0$ 与 $f(x)=x^2$ 均满足原方程。
